warnings: No dimensions are given in the text or images. The Romi base plate diameter is about 163 mm, and the description says this plate has the same diameter but is only a half circle, so x is about 160 mm and y is about 85 mm (slightly more than a radius because of the side tabs). Z of about 10 mm is a rough estimate for the thin plate plus the downward rim. Hole diameter and position are placeholders for a typical 3-4 mm mounting hole; the plate has many holes and slots in different sizes, and their exact positions and sizes could not be measured, so only one representative hole is listed. Bosses, hex cutouts, and slots are visible but not dimensioned.
Bounds used literally (X160, Y85, Z10), so the plate lies in the XY plane with thickness along Z, though the rules put the bottom at Y=0.
Hole and slot positions and sizes are representative approximations; the real plate has a much denser irregular pattern.
Hex cutouts, corner standoff bosses, rim notches and side tabs/notches were omitted as uncertain.
Deck and rim thicknesses are estimates; all dimensions are unverified.
